Plan: Project Module Buildout
Design and wire two new backoffice experiences: a paginated /backoffice/projects table fed by projects.list, plus a five-step creation wizard under /backoffice/projects/new orchestrating the required POST flows (projects.create, survey builder APIs, respondents/subjects uploads, and publish). Each step must persist state, honor language/scale selections, and surface validation/errors per CSV templates.

Steps
Add new routes (app/routes/backoffice/projects.tsx, .../projects.new.tsx) using existing dashboard layout and shadcn primitives.
Implement projects.list hook integration with URL-based pagination/search, table UI, and empty/filter states mirroring company pages.
Build Step 1 form hooked to projects.create (languages multi-select, RatingScaleType select, optimistic state cache).
Construct Step 2/3 flow manager storing wizard context; call survey template endpoints when needed and render per-language question editors with validation.
Implement Step 4 CSV uploaders using template column order, preview cards, and /bulk-upsert mutations with error display.
Finish Step 5 summary screen aggregating prior step data and trigger projects.publish on confirmation.
Further Considerations
Need confirmation on desired columns/actions for the list table (edit, duplicate, delete?). Options: basic view vs. full CRUD controls.
Wizard navigation UX: allow backtracking/editing previous steps or enforce linear progression?
Storage strategy for in-progress wizard data (local component state vs. dedicated store) should be aligned before implementation.





Answer:
1. In the table there will be edits and details, because when you finish step 1 you will have created a project, which means if you don't continue it then the project will already exist because it was created in step 1, so in the table there will be an edit to continue filling in the project that was created in step 1, and details to see a summary of the projects that have been created.
2. The wizard can backtrack and edit previous steps
3. For temporary data storage, store it in the local component state only, because the data is not too complex

Oh yes, to add, there are category and subcategory fields in creating questions, now this category is in select form where the options are still empty. Later in the selection there is a feature to add a new category, so when you add a new category it will only be saved in the local state, then this subcategory depends on the category selected, for example if you choose category A then the subcategory will also still be empty if you haven't previously added a subcategory for category A, then when you add a new subcategory it will be saved in the local state too, so basically category and subcategory This is only saved in the local state, there is no need to save it to the backend because this is only for filling in questions in the survey builder step. But these categories and subcategories must also be persisted when moving steps so that when you return to the survey builder step, the category and subcategory data that has been added is not lost. If you think it's better to just save it in local storage so that when you refresh the page it doesn't disappear, please just adjust it. but it will have to be deleted again when the project is published in the last step.
and this data is actually free text, so later on, for example if you edit the data, the data is already in the backend, then the categories and subcategories are taken from the data in the backend only, if you want to change it you can add new categories and subcategories.
